item.title: Joe Caine found guilty of murder, sentenced to 45 years
item.description: District Attorney Michael Murray reported that on Friday, Nov. 21, a Brown County jury convicted Joe Caine of the murder of Tony Roberts. On Monday, Nov. 25, Judge Mike Smith sentenced Caine to 45 years in prison.
